column1: # INV-BUBBLE's rules (tools/scenarios/checks.sh): what a desk's bubble, greeting or tile line may say, against the
# server as it really is at that moment. One rule a line, TAB-separated:
#   <desk>  <lang key or glob>  <jq condition over the facts: true = the line may show now>  <why, one line>
# The facts are read from the server itself, not from the office's own state files (checks.sh bubble_facts; printed
# Every key whose condition is false is handed to the page check (page.mjs --not): the page built from the real state
# files at that moment must not show it. A greeting (greet.N, picked at random) is looked for in one drawing per
# greeting (Math.random pinned) — the desk's own filter decides, the rule says when the line would be untrue.
